name: Element Kuala Lumpur
short_description: A long-stay-oriented Element occupying the top floors of the Foster + Partners-designed Ilham Tower on Jalan Binjai, near KLCC.
ai_summary: Element Kuala Lumpur occupies the upper floors of Ilham Tower on Jalan Binjai, a Green Building Index-certified skyscraper designed by Foster + Partners, with its lobby on the 40th floor and rooms spanning floors 41 to 53. The Petronas Twin Towers are visible and within a short distance, and KLCC's convention centre and Pavilion mall are both under two kilometers away. Built for both short stopovers and longer stays, the hotel features studios and suites with floor-to-ceiling windows, in-room kitchenettes, and the brand's signature Westin Heavenly Bed. Guest reviews consistently highlight the dramatic skyline views from height, spacious and comfortable rooms, and a relaxed, modern design aesthetic. Executive suites with two bathrooms and a full living room draw specific praise for longer-stay guests. Marriott Bonvoy elite members report feeling well recognized here. The complaints that surface are minor and mostly about finishing touches -- some guests suggest larger or thicker towels, ceramic rather than plastic toilet seats, and better TV console setups, and at least one review noted frustration when an in-app request for extra towels wasn't fulfilled. It suits business travelers, longer-stay guests wanting a kitchenette, and anyone prioritizing height and skyline views near KLCC.

faqs.question: Does Element Kuala Lumpur have kitchenettes?
faqs.answer: Yes -- as a long-stay-oriented Marriott Bonvoy brand, Element Kuala Lumpur's studios and suites include in-room kitchenettes, and Executive Suites add a full living room and two and a half bathrooms, making it well suited to extended stays.

faqs.question: Where is Element Kuala Lumpur located?
faqs.answer: It occupies the upper floors, 41 through 53, of Ilham Tower on Jalan Binjai near KLCC, with the lobby on the 40th floor, putting the Petronas Twin Towers, KLCC convention centre, and Pavilion mall all within about two kilometers.
